verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an explicit 'md' output format described as a markdown-formatted version optimized for LLMs/AI agents, plus a raw 'html' option, going beyond default JSON snippets — but this is documented specifically for the Google News API, not confirmed for the flagship Google Search API in the evidence pack. There's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the markdown output's completeness or fidelity for arbitrary search results. missing for 10: explicit documentation that md/html formats apply to Google Search API (not just News API), independent verification that md output contains full page text rather than just formatted snippet data.
